task_summary: Enter eligible free, fully remote competitions using carefully polished permitted works. This repository is one prepared work; actual registrations and submissions remain zero across the private execution ledger.

evidence: README.md links a working local browser application and public preview, with the original participation task explicitly incomplete.
The execution ledger has zero organizer registration and submission receipts; the separate ARC baseline is held after 0/167 public evaluation outputs.
devpost/qa-results.json records 45 passed core/workspace tests and exact source hashes.
Actual browser checks distinguish saved plans, existing registrations after a join cutoff, final deadlines, removed bookmarks and isolated demo data.
Browser export, file-chooser restore, cancel, undo and reload were exercised against a real downloaded backup.
390px navigation and a reproduced stale-tab overwrite were verified after repair; hosted interaction/video playback remain unverified despite exact public file equality.
docs/core.mjs and docs/workspace.mjs isolate deterministic validation and backup normalization from UI handling.
The static application introduces no new runtime dependencies; git diff --check passed after the final documentation review.
Demo receipts cannot be restored into personal mode; malformed data and credential-bearing URLs are rejected.
Publication audit checked 44 repository files with zero entrant email/candidate-password matches; actual account creation and contest actions are not fabricated.
.codex/APP_STATE.md, TASKS.md and HANDOFF.md identify account, video-hosting, public-browser and actual submission gaps.
devpost/qa-results.json, hosting-verification.json and versioned raw capture provenance make local and public evidence independently traceable.

known_gaps.description: No Devpost account creation or organizer entry/submission receipt; new credential entry requires the user to complete the browser handoff.
The public YouTube/Vimeo link required by this contest is missing; entrant-only personal statements have not been invented.
Public files exactly match tested local bytes, but remote browser calls timed out; hosted interactions and video playback remain unverified.
Other eligible competition works remain unfinished; ineligible, human-authored-only and genuine-photography requirements cannot be bypassed by submitting this app.
